name: L-arogenate to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine
summary: A 6-step route from L-arogenate(1−) to S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine zwitterion, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 1-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = homogentisate + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: homogentisate phytyltransferase
reactions.equation: phytyl diphosphate + homogentisate + H(+) = 2-methyl-6-phytyl-1,4-benzene-1,4-diol + CO2 + diphosphate

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (guanine(745)-N(1))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(745) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(1)-methylguanosine(745) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (guanine(748)-N(1))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(748) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(1)-methylguanosine(748) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: a 1,N(6)-etheno-2'-deoxyadenosine in double-stranded DNA + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 + H2O = ...
reactions.equation: a 1,N(6)-etheno-2'-deoxyadenosine in double-stranded DNA + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 + H2O = a 2'-deoxyadenosine in double-stranded DNA + glyoxal + succinate + CO2

reactions.name: L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = L-glutamate + NADPH + 2 H(+)
reactions.equation: L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = L-glutamate + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: fumigaclavine A dimethylallyltransferase
reactions.equation: fumigaclavine A + dimethylallyl diphosphate = fumigaclavine C + diphosphate

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (uracil(1939)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(1939) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methyluridine(1939) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (uracil(1498)-N(3))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(1498) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(3)-methyluridine(1498) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (cytidine(32)/uridine(32)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (cytidine(32)/uridine(32)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyluridine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)
